head: DooDay poop tracker app: one tap logs a bowel movement on iPhone
dek: DooDay: Poop Tracker is a 1.99-dollar iPhone and iPad app where you tap "I Pooped!" to log a bowel movement and look back over a calendar. It came out on 22 November and was #63 among paid Health & Fitness apps on the US App Store on 25 November.
details: It also has a "Things I Took" log, a PDF export for sharing, and reminders when you haven't logged anything for 1 to 10 days. All six colour themes are included, and tips are optional. It needs no account and keeps the data on your device; the listing says it isn't medical advice. It's made by Julie Dody Mancuso.
where: iPhone and iPad, App Store, 1.99 dollars
means: If you need to keep track for yourself or for a doctor's visit, this logs it with one tap and keeps it on your phone.
todo: Get it from the App Store; nothing needs an account, and the PDF export is there when you want to share your history.
